title: The sheaf of differentials of a formally smooth morphism of algebraic spaces is locally projective
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a formally smooth morphism of algebraic spaces the sheaf of differentials is locally projective and that its first cohomology vanishes on affine pieces. The proof chooses an etale chart, transports the statement to the chart using the compatibility of differentials with etale localisation, and then invokes the affine computation of the relevant cohomology. Passing the local projectivity and the cohomology vanishing through the etale chart is what the argument turns on rather than any single local computation. Retained author proof at lines 4768-4773 with the surrounding argument.
